z-m-30-01.title: Wetin come after 1, 2, 4?
z-m-30-01.topic: Matrix powers: how many values needed to know pattern?
z-m-30-01.goal: Understand say many rules fit small matrix-power values, remove possible rules and change judgment along the way, explain say general formula sure only after reason found (the structure).
z-m-30-01.material: B na 2×2 matrix, and all 4 entries (row 1 column 1, row 1 column 2, row 2 column 1, row 2 column 2) na 1. B^n na matrix from multiplying B n times. All entries real numbers and n integer at least 1. Two friends dey talk about B³ entries. One talk say, "The entries of B¹ and B² are 1 and 2, so B³ is 3," and other talk say, "I'm not sure yet. Let's multiply more." Each time data show, change judgment or keep am.
z-m-30-01.thinking.0: When making rule from little data, also consider other possible rules
z-m-30-01.thinking.1: Changing judgment and confidence with new information
z-m-30-01.thinking.2: Finding first wrong solution line and explaining why
z-m-30-01.thinking.3: Making general formula with letters (p, n) and stating reason
z-m-30-01.prereq.0: Multiplication for 2×2 matrices (one product entry = sum of products from one front row and one back column) and powers A^n = A times itself n times
z-m-30-01.prereq.1: Reading expressions with n and p and finding simple number patterns
z-m-30-01.prereq.2: School sequence assumption: the H2 of this task only label production difficulty no mean Ministry of Education assign am to one grade. Assume e follow after matrix multiplication lesson, induction or determinants no needed.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.prompt: Data come one step at a time. Each step choose your current idea about B powers entries.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.hint.0: Every step write all rules matching numbers so far, and see which new info rule out.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.hint.1: Check if you only think one rule, or also consider others.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.info: B¹ na B itself, so all 4 entries na 1. When dem multiply B² directly, all 4 entries na 2.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: What about B³ entries? Choose your current judgment.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Both 3 and 4 fit the data. You can take one rule as a 'working hypothesis,' but before check, keep other possibilities open.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: All entries na 3. After 1, 2, add 1 rule continue
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Other rules fit 1 and 2 apart from 'increase by 1.' With only 2 data, too early to choose one rule.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: All entries na 4. After 1, 2, doubling rule continue
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Doubling rule fit 1,2 too, but so do 'increase by 1.' See say too early to choose one and feel sure. (1 and 2)
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: We no fit choose 3 or 4 now, so calculate B³ directly
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: You notice 2 data points fit different rules so you hold judgment. You even think of how to check (multiplying directly).
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: All entries na 2. All matrix entries same, so value no change again
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: For B², value don change from 1 to 2. Same entries no mean value no change.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.info: When dem multiply B³ direct, all 4 entries na 4. So far na 1,2,4. The rule that fits these numbers is not only 'doubling.' Add previous 2 values then add 1 give 1, 2, 4, 7, ..., and e match too. (1 2 4 7)
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Wetin you judge now about B⁴??
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Because of B³, 'increase by 1' has been eliminated. But we no fit separate doubling rule from 1,2,4,7 rule until calculate B⁴. You need more data or find reason. (1 2 4 7)
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Choose doubling and say all B⁴ entries na 8
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: True, the 3 values match doubling, but 1,2,4,7 rule match too. You never separate both yet. (1 2 4 7)
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Treat B³ value 4 as mistake and keep first rule say all be 3
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: If you call direct calculation mistake, you fit keep first judgment without evidence. Rechecking calculation different from ignoring am.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Different rules dey, so no guess at all from data
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: 'Increase by 1' no longer match. Knowing fewer rules still fit na information too.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Drop 'increase by 1,' then separate remaining 2 rules using B⁴
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: You remove rule wey no match data and think how to distinguish remaining rules.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.info: I find a reason. Assume all 4 B^n entries equal k. One B^(n+1)=B^n×B entry na (k × 1) + (k × 1) = 2k. Same calculation apply to all 4 entries. All B¹ entries na 1.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Now how you judge B^n and B⁵ entries?
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.after: All-same entry shape remain each time and value double, so B^n entries na 2^(n−1). The judgment we leave open at first as 'whether it is 3 or 4' get more clear from data → possible rules → reason. Student wey calculate B⁴ direct go get same answer.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: All B^n entries na n, and B⁵ entries na 5
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: n rule already fail for B³. E no match new info too (2k each time we multiply).
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: All entries of B^n na 2^(n−1), and all entries of B⁵ na 16.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: You connect answer with reason 'each multiplication gives 2k' wey apply for every n.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: E likely be 2^(n−1), but I no sure until calculate B⁵ direct
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wanting to check good. But new info give reason wey work for any n. Think how reason change your confidence.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: B⁴ na 7, so B⁵ all na 12
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: You keep 1,2,4,7 rule. Check if this fit new info say k turn to 2k. (1 2 4 7)
z-m-30-01.s.s1.reflect: From holding judgment first to being sure at end, wetin change your confidence? What difference did gathering three more data points and finding the 'reason' make to your confidence?
z-m-30-01.s.s2.prompt: Hayun, classmate, find entries for powers of C = 3B (a matrix whose four entries are all 3) like this. Choose first wrong line.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.hint.0: Choose one C entry and calculate direct the (row 1, column 1) entry of C multiply by itself twice.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.hint.1: Compare the value you calculate directly with each line, and find the first line wey dem no match.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.line.1: Every entry of B² na 2, so every entry of C² na 3×2=6.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.line.2: The same way, C³=3B³, and each B³ entry na 4, so every C³ entry na 3×4=12.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.line.3: So every entry of C^n na 3×2^(n−1).
z-m-30-01.s.s2.explain: For line 1, the constant 3 dey in both factors, but dem take am out only once. In (3B)(3B), 3 show twice, so C²=9B² and every entry na 9×2=18. If you square C directly and calculate one entry only, 3×3+3×3=18, so you go see say e different from 6. Lines 2 to 4 use the wrong line 1 expression, so dem wrong too. For the same reason, line 3 should be C³=27B³ and the entries na 108.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.prompt: Now take matrix P where all 4 entries equal p (p na positive integer). Write every entry of P^n, P multiplied by itself n times, using p and n, and explain your reason.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.hint.0: For p=1 and p=2, multiply P² directly, then compare the entries.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.hint.1: Write an expression showing how P² entries connect to P entries and p, then check if the same thing happen for P³.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.placeholder: Example: All entries of P^n na ... because ...
z-m-30-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: If I put p=1 in my expression, do the entries of B^n come out as 2^(n−1) again?
z-m-30-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Did I check if the values match direct multiplication when n=1 and n=2?
z-m-30-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Did I write the main reason, like “why one entry calculation enough” or “factor B out”?
z-m-30-01.s.s3.model.0: Every entry of P^n na p^n×2^(n−1). If P=pB, then P^n=p^nB^n, and each B^n entry double every time.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.modelNote.0: The method wey factor B out.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.model.1: The entries go p, 2p², 4p³, ...; every time we multiply once, dem become 2p times bigger. The four entries keep the same shape, and one entry na p×k+p×k=2pk, so every P^n entry na p×(2p)^(n−1).
z-m-30-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: The method wey start from how one multiplication change am. The expression same as the last answer.
